title: Concept: Phoenix LiveDashboard disclosed
description: LiveDashboard is a live view of the node: process counts, ETS tables, application supervision trees and, on an attached node, the metric history. It is also a LiveView endpoint, so the socket it opens carries the same reachability.
applicability: Responses from a Phoenix application that mounts the dashboard in every environment.
risk: The caller learns the supervision tree and the module names of the running release, then uses the socket to watch the node.
